answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7905 Country: India Title: Sometimes, in local flight travel or international travel, the plane will be small and there would not be enough place to offer Salah standing. In such a situation, can we offer Salah by sitting on our seat itself ? Question: As-salamu-Alaikum, Sometimes, in local flight travel or international travel, the plane will be small and there would not be enough place to offer Salah standing. In such a situation, can we offer Salah by sitting on our seat itself ? Jazakallah humma khair! Answer ID: 7905 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2033/308=TB/1429) Yes, you can pray salah sitting at your seat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
